code.text: COAG

text.div:
Annotation

Conclusion and Recommendations based on this report and previous findings known to us:
The patient shows mild hypoxemia, leukopenia, thrombocytopenia, mild hypoglycemia, elevated creatinine, increased D-dimer, ferritin, CRP, INR, and mild monocytosis and basophilia. These findings suggest systemic inflammation, possible infection or sepsis, and impaired renal function. The elevated INR and D-dimer may indicate coagulopathy. Close clinical correlation and urgent evaluation for underlying causes, including infection and organ dysfunction, are recommended.
